From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

Catalan

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Late Latin apparātōrem.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): (Central, Balearic) [ə.pə.ɾəˈðo]
  • IPA(key): (Valencia) [a.pa.ɾaˈðoɾ]
  • Audio (Barcelona):(file)
  • Rhymes: -o(ɾ)

Noun

[edit]

aparador m (plural aparadors)

  1. cupboard
  2. display case, shop window

Further reading

[edit]
  • “aparador”, in Diccionari de la llengua catalana [Dictionary of the Catalan Language] (in Catalan), second edition, Institute of Catalan Studies [Catalan: Institut d'Estudis Catalans], April 2007
  • “aparador”, in Gran Diccionari de la Llengua Catalana, Grup Enciclopèdia Catalana, 2026
  • “aparador” in Diccionari normatiu valencià, Acadèmia Valenciana de la Llengua.
  • “aparador” in Diccionari català-valencià-balear, Antoni Maria Alcover and Francesc de Borja Moll, 1962.

Hiligaynon

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Spanish aparador.

Noun

[edit]

aparadór

  1. cupboard, dresser, sideboard

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

From Late Latin apparātor (literally “preparer”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /apaɾaˈdoɾ/ [a.pa.ɾaˈð̞oɾ]
  • Audio (Colombia):(file)
  • Rhymes: -oɾ
  • Syllabification: a‧pa‧ra‧dor

Noun

[edit]

aparador m (plural aparadores)

  1. (furniture) sideboard
  2. shop window
    Synonym: escaparate
  3. (dated except Philippines) wardrobe (a closet or piece of furniture for holding clothes)
    Synonyms: armario, ropero, alacena

Descendants

[edit]
  • → Hiligaynon: aparadór
  • → Tagalog: aparador

Further reading

[edit]
  • “aparador”, in Diccionario de la lengua española [Dictionary of the Spanish Language] (in Spanish), online version 23.8.1, Royal Spanish Academy [Spanish: Real Academia Española], 15 December 2025

Tagalog

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from Spanish aparador, from Late Latin apparātor (literally “preparer”).

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (Standard Tagalog) IPA(key): /ʔapaɾaˈdoɾ/ [ʔɐ.pɐ.ɾɐˈd̪oɾ]
  • Rhymes: -oɾ
  • Syllabification: a‧pa‧ra‧dor

Noun

[edit]

aparadór (Baybayin spelling ᜀᜉᜇᜇᜓᜇ᜔)

  1. wardrobe; clothes closet; dresser
  2. cupboard; sideboard
    Synonym: paminggalan
